result.title: A Stronger Teacher Within: Strengthening MoE Models via On-Policy Bidirectional Distillation
result.summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, but its outcome-level rewards provide only sparse supervision. On-Policy Distillation offers dense token-level feedback, yet requires a stronger compatible teacher, while on-policy self-distillation relies on hand-designed privileged information. We observe that the MoE architecture itself offers a way to resolve this dilemma, as increasing the activation budget per token exposes latent expert capacity and yields a potentially stronger teacher within the model. However, naive expansion degrades performance because newly co-activated experts are not optimized to work together. We therefore propose MoEvolve, a bidirectional distillation framework following a recovery-then-improvement strategy: we first restore the activation-expanded high-$k$ model and further strengthen it by exploiting its additional active capacity, then reverse the direction of distillation to transfer the enhanced capabilities back into the original low-$k$ configuration, retaining its inference-time activation budget. Across diverse MoE models and benchmarks, MoEvolve improves the initial models by up to $22.2$ domain-average points and outperforms same-budget RLVR baselines by up to $6.5$ points. Notably, the final low-$k$ models often surpass their activation-expanded teachers.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MoEvolve，通过提高 MoE 每 token 激活专家预算得到「模型内部的更强教师」，先恢复并强化高 k 配置，再反向蒸馏把增强能力迁回原始低 k 配置，在多个 MoE LLM 与基准上提升并优于同预算 RLVR。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以内部扩展激活/privileged 配置为教师、双向 on-policy 蒸馏回低预算推理配置」的思路，可能为 LVR 中如何用更重计算的隐状态/轨迹监督轻量推理状态、以及贡献分配提供方法线索，但属纯文本 MoE 场景，迁移可行性需核查。
